Pace University

What Will You Be Known to Do?

Pace turns potential into proof through an education built around opportunity, experience, and personal attention. In New York City, Westchester, and online, you’ll have the access and support to build something real from what you learn.

New York City

Visit Pace. Earn a $2,000 Grant.

Visit Pace’s New York City or Westchester Campus by December 15, 2026, and eligible students who enroll full time for Fall 2027 will receive a renewable $2,000 grant.

Schedule Your Visit

Choose Your Pace Experience

New York City Campus

New York City Campus

Study in Lower Manhattan, where campus and city life come together and the industries, people, and opportunities shaping what’s next are right outside your door.

Explore the NYC Campus

Westchester Campus

Westchester Campus

Set across 200 acres, Pace Westchester gives you space to focus, room to grow, and a close-knit New York campus experience connected to opportunity across the region.

Explore the Westchester Campus

Haub Law Campus

Haub Law Campus

Nationally recognized faculty, centers and clinics. The nation’s top environmental law program. And with a strategic location in White Plains, the opportunities are limitless.

Explore the Haub Law Campus

Pace Online

Pace Online

Build your Pace experience from wherever you are, with flexible programs, experienced faculty, and support designed to fit alongside work, family, and everything else in your life.

Explore Pace Online

Apply to Pace for Free This October and November

Apply now for Fall 2027. Undergraduates can apply for free throughout October and November.

Apply Now

Known to Put Careers in Motion

At Pace, experience starts before graduation. Internships, clinicals, research, performances, and professional projects give you opportunities to apply what you’re learning in real settings. Career Services helps you build on that experience with guidance, employer connections, and support as you prepare for what comes after college.

Explore Career Services

Notice of Nondiscriminatory Policy

Pace University admits students of any race, color, national and ethnic origin to all the rights, privileges, programs, and activities generally accorded or made available to students at the school. It does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national and ethnic origin in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and loan programs, and athletic and any other school-administered programs
